messages.author: 6873525055e7cfa8
messages.subject: Bar width in facet_grid
parts:
Dear ggplot experts!

I am trying to plot some bar plot with errorbars ordered according to
two factors using "fill=factor_1" for factor_1 and facet_grid for
factor_2.

The width of the bars and of the whole plot windows is set according
to the total plot window size. I would prefer if I could keep the bar
width fix across plots so that the bar width is the same in all plots.
It would be nicer to compare.

Many thanks for your help & best wishes,
Jokel

library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
# create some dummy data
name <-
c("Name_1","Name_2","Name_3","Name_1","Name_2","Name_3","Name_1","Name_2","Name_3","Name_1")
factor_1 <- c("A","B","A","B","A","B","A","B","A","B")
factor_2 <- c("C","C","C","D","D","D","E","E","C","E")
mean <- c(1.2,1.5,-2.1,1.9,-0.5,0.9,1.2,1.5,-2.1,-1.1)
sd <- c(0.2,0.5,0.1,0.1,0.25,0.4,0.2,0.5,0.1,0.1)
data <-
data.frame(name=name,factor_1=factor_1,factor_2=factor_2,mean=mean,sd=sd)
data_1 <- data[1:7,]
data_2 <- data[8:10,]


# plot
#par(mfrow=c(2,1))

p1 <- ggplot(data_1,aes(x=name, y=mean, fill=factor_1))
+geom_bar(stat="identity", positio="dodge")
+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-sd,ymax=mean+sd))+facet_grid(~factor_2,
scales="free_x", space="free")

p2 <- ggplot(data_2,aes(x=name, y=mean, fill=factor_1))
+geom_bar(stat="identity", positio="dodge")
+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-sd,ymax=mean+sd))+facet_grid(~factor_2,
scales="free_x", space="free")

grid.arrange(p1,p2)

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Bar width in facet_grid
parts:
Your code didn't run for me (bad line breaks), but I don't think
there's currently anyway to solve this problem, although we are
thinking about it - eventually you'll be able to access a rich
"gtable" object which you can easily inspect to get row and column
dimensions.

Hadley
